title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour to Great Southern Bank Arena, with the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals on the court. Fans can help decide the action, get pulled onto the court, and take over the jumbotron, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM. It is aimed at families and fans of all kinds, including first-time families, on Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
